| [`line-spacing-on-edges.tentative.html`](https://wpt.fyi/results/css/css-ruby/line-spacing-on-edges.tentative.html) | Fail | 0 / 3 | NOT IMPLEMENTED | the annotations of the first line of a block container use the space before it (its block-start margin, the space after the content of the last line of the previous block), as Chrome does (https://github.com/w3c/csswg-drafts/issues/14405): the first line is extended by its annotations, because the stable tests css/css-ruby/ruby-annotation-pairing-001.html, ruby-annotation-with-margin.html and css/css-text-decor/text-emphasis-color-001.xht expect the annotations of a first line inside the paragraph even when it has a margin; the first subtest passes when the block-start margin is used |
